_comment: FC 26's identity and module list, read by scripts/game_config.py (the Makefile, the scripts and the tests take them from here). Facts from games/fc26/docs/BRIEFING.md, measured 2026-10-22: base game 1.0.0, no DLC; ExeFS main, sdk, rtld, main.npdm and no subsdk0. Since story H1 (2026-10-23) the port runs the update v1638400 (display version 1.89.6e65 from its control.nacp; main build id 323f3a9f..., sdk and rtld byte-identical to 1.0.0's, main.npdm differs), with the update's RomFS merged over the base's; the base's pins stay in assets/expected-v1.0.0.json. modules: what the runtime maps, relocates and initialises, in that order (main first: the probe calls main's PLT and boot reports offsets in main); each one is rewritten to rewritten/<version_dir>/<name>.patched.bin. analysis_modules: what prepare_modules.py turns into analysis ELF.
name: FC 26
